structured_output.world_model: W2 empirical, after E010. The tip is 6.639 s at 0.7548. The only measured levers are the epoch dial and the width cut, at about 0.05 pp per 1% of time. Muon, EMA and prog-res were all gains. The LR-floor change (E009) gave no gain. The margin over 0.753 is only 0.17 pp, so most recipe tweaks that are not measured here are coin flips of about ±0.3 pp. Lossless systems work is the safest path to lower time. Diagnostics (I016, I021) cost no recipe change, and I021 can only reduce time if there are real host syncs.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic with no recipe change. The reported metrics should match E010. The held-out mean is likely within 0.3 pp of 0.7548, but that is not something the run's own metrics settle.
Short runs with EMA usually like heavy label smoothing, and LS 0.3 was tuned for the port. The effect is probably within noise either way.
Muon lr was never tuned on CIFAR-100. A ×1.5 step could go either way. Muon already surprised on the upside, so a small positive tilt is plausible but not measured.
With only 8.5 epochs, less wd could help slightly. Muon's fixed-norm weights make wd mostly irrelevant for conv filters, so the effect is likely small.
The code already uses 3 Newton-Schulz steps, so the idea may be a no-op or the result may simply match E010. Muon cost about 0.35 s in total, so any saving is at most about 0.05 s.

Compiled steps are likely already near the GPU limit. The Python augmentation loop with 25 masked copies per epoch could be the one real saving, so a small time gain is possible with unchanged accuracy.
The Lookahead reset is part of what produced E005's large gain. A plain EMA with no reset to the fast weights probably recovers less than all of it, so it likely falls short of the 0.753 bar.

cruxes: Is the E010 recipe GPU-bound or launch/host-bound under the 4-CPU pin? This decides whether systems work (CUDA graphs, fusing the augmentation) can still save time.
What is the 10-seed mean for E010, i.e. the held-out offset from 0.7548? It decides whether the 0.17 pp margin is real.
Is the optimum for Muon lr, wd and label smoothing on CIFAR-100 away from the CIFAR-10 values? A gain of 0.3 pp or more would buy about 0.5 epoch.
